build_RTDetrHungarianMatcher: build an RT-DETR Hungarian matcher that assigns predictions to ground truth targets using cost-based bipartite matching
run_RTDetrLoss_forward: run the RT-DETR loss computation with matched predictions and targets to produce classification and box losses
test_loss_labels_vfl: test the verified focal loss method that computes classification loss using IoU-guided target scores for RT-DETR
compute_loss_boxes: compute L1 and GIoU regression losses for matched bounding box predictions and ground truth targets
call_RTDetrForObjectDetectionLoss: call the RT-DETR object detection loss function with logits, predicted boxes, and config to return total loss and per-loss dict
